ledger.note: 457 BC: Zhao annexes Dai. Zhao Wuxu (Zhao Xiangzi) invited the Dai king to a feast where his men massacred the leading men; 'he then swiftly invaded, overran, and annexed the lands of Dai to his realm'; the Dai queen, his sister, killed herself.
